title: KdsHistoryDrawer DEEP audit — lifecycle, WCAG 2.1.2 Escape, multi-day, Z-close integration, allergens, perf
head: 07e147cc16b238a34041a1fad2a83bb11c58091c
head_note: Spec stated HEAD d601fdd34 (2026-05-23); working tree is 2 commits ahead at 07e147cc1 ('docs(phase-l-wave-c-final)...'). No changes to KdsHistoryDrawer.vue between the two commits — drawer last modified at 4428e3ca4 (Wave X3 2026-05-21 ship commit). Verdict is therefore stable across both refs.
scope: Deep audit of resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KdsHistoryDrawer.vue (Wave X3 read-only V1 day-history drawer). Covers open/close lifecycle, content per BRAIN spec, allergen visibility, multi-day support, performance, focus management (WCAG 2.4.3), Z-close integration, and recall integration. Includes backend wire-format check (KDSOrderDetailsResource), endpoint test cross-reference (KdsHistoryTodayEndpointTest), structural sentinel run (kdsHistoryDrawerSentinel), and bundle freshness sentinel run (kdsBundleFreshnessSentinel).
verdict_rationale: Drawer ships the Wave X3 read-only contract correctly: 4 mutually-exclusive states (loading / error / empty / list), endpoint match (admin/kds-order/history-today), status 8/10/13 mapping to FR-translated labels (Prêt / En livraison / Livré), no Renvoyer / revert / recall control (per V1 contract — V1.0.2 LOCK), backend branch isolation + 50-cap + Paris-local TZ bounds verified by 6 endpoint tests (it_returns_today_prepared_out_and_delivered_orders_only, it_sorts_by_updated_at_descending, it_enforces_branch_isolation_for_branch_staff, admin_branch_id_zero_sees_all_branches, it_caps_at_50_orders, it_uses_tz_aware_paris_local_bounds_not_utc, unauthenticated_request_is_denied). WCAG 2.1.2 Escape-key handler PASS — verified at KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:193-207, mounted-time listener gated by `this.open`, beforeUnmount teardown prevents listener leak. Structural sentinel 12/12 GREEN. NO V1 ship blocker. 4 findings DOCUMENTED — 1 P1 (updated_at field NOT exposed by KDSOrderDetailsResource → drawer renders empty <time> on every row), 3 P2 (ARIA-contract drift role=dialog/aria-modal=true without focus trap, no allergen badge in history rows asymmetric with KdsOrderCard, multi-day filter absent — owner-night 'review last week' use case unsupported). 1 INFRA finding (R) — kdsBundleFreshnessSentinel currently RED: fr.json mtime 2026-05-23T20:32:23Z is newer than public/js/admin-kds.js mtime 2026-05-23T13:55:49Z. Drawer i18n strings still render correctly today because the existing label.kds_history_* keys ship in the current bundle, but ANY edit to a kds_* key since 13:55 would not appear until rebuild.

escape_wcag_2_1_2.evidence: KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:193-207 — mounted() installs document keydown listener `_onEsc` gated by `this.open && (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'Esc')` → `$emit('close')`. beforeUnmount() removes the listener and nulls the reference. Compatible with both modern (Escape) and legacy IE-era (Esc) key strings. Listener is a no-op when drawer closed, so it cannot fire spurious close events on the parent shell. G.5 fix (Wave Polish) verified.

multi_day_support.evidence: Backend KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService::historyToday() at line 217-246 hard-codes `Carbon::today($appTz)` and `Carbon::tomorrow($appTz)` as the whereBetween bounds. No `?date=YYYY-MM-DD` query param, no range selector in drawer template. Owner-night persona reviewing last week is unsupported — only today's PREPARED/OUT/DELIVERED is visible. Status: V1 scope as designed (Wave X3 read-only V1). Documented as V1.0.2 backlog if owner mandates multi-day review pattern.

z_close_integration.evidence: Historique uses wall-clock day (Paris-local 00:00:00 → 23:59:59.999 next-day-tomorrow) NOT the fiscal Z-period. Z opens at L2-HEAL-07 (00:05 local cron) and closes at G2-HEAL-06 (23:55 local cron), so Z-period and wall-clock day overlap closely BUT NOT IDENTICALLY. Edge case: orders bumped between 23:55 (Z closes) and 00:00 (Historique day rolls over) belong to the just-closed Z but remain in 'today' Historique for a 5-minute window, then VANISH from Historique at 00:00 while still being part of the closed Z's audit chain. Similarly orders bumped 00:00-00:05 appear in 'today' Historique BEFORE the new Z is opened. Edge-case, NOT a fiscal bug (NF525 chain integrity is independent of this view). Should be called out in operational docs so chef knows Historique ≠ Z-report.

findings.summary: KDSOrderDetailsResource does NOT expose `updated_at` field, but KdsHistoryDrawer.vue renders `<time :datetime="order.updated_at">{{ formatTime(order.updated_at) }}</time>` on every row. Result in production: the bumped-at timestamp column is EMPTY on every Historique row (formatTime() catch-all returns '' when input is undefined). Chef sees N°, status pill, item lines, but cannot tell at which time the order was bumped — the central use case for the drawer ('verify content if customer reports error 20 min after bump').

evidence.resource_producer: app/Http/Resources/KDSOrderDetailsResource.php:19-73 — toArray() returns 20 keys: id, order_serial_no, token, order_type, source_surface, created_at_iso, order_datetime, order_date, order_time, delivery_date, delivery_time, is_advance_order, preparation_time, status, status_name, payment_status, payment_pending_counter, queue_number, order_items, table_name. `updated_at` is NOT in this list.
evidence.formatTime_fallback: KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:256-266 — formatTime(undefined) returns '' (early return on !value). User sees empty <time> element, no 'undefined' raw label leak — but no time displayed either.

findings.blast_radius: Drawer-local UX degradation — empty time column makes 'which order was bumped at 14:32?' impossible to answer from Historique alone. Chef would have to cross-reference the active KdsV2Grid Wave U 'Récemment servies' strip (which only shows the last few). Not a fiscal / NF525 issue, not a security issue, not a sync issue. findings.summary: Drawer declares `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` (line 27-28) but does NOT implement the WAI-ARIA dialog pattern contract: no focus trap (Tab cycles out of drawer into background page), no initial-focus restorer (focus does NOT move into drawer on open), no return-focus on close (focus does NOT restore to the 'Historique' trigger button). Phase L5.3 audit treated drawer as 'SLIDE-IN PANEL (not a true blocking dialog)' which is correct UX but inconsistent with the ARIA contract the source itself declares. Screen reader users hear 'dialog, modal' but find a non-trap, non-restoring overlay.

evidence.missing_implementation: grep -nE 'ref="|focus\(\)|nextTick|onMounted|returnFocus' KdsHistoryDrawer.vue = 0 hits. No this.$refs, no .focus() call, no Tab interception.
evidence.phase_l_audit_quote: phase-l/L5.3-keyboard-nav-findings.json: 'KdsHistoryDrawer is a SLIDE-IN PANEL (not a true blocking dialog) — backdrop click + Escape both close it (line 195).' — L5.3 implicitly acknowledges the drift but verdict was PASS because nothing was broken.
evidence.wai_aria_spec: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices 1.2 §3.7 (Dialog (Modal)): 'When a modal dialog opens, focus moves to an element within the dialog'; 'TAB: Moves focus to the next tabbable element inside the dialog'; 'When a dialog closes, focus returns to the element that invoked the dialog.'

recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: Option A (RECOMMENDED — simpler, matches actual UX): drop aria-modal="true" + change role="dialog" → role="complementary" or role="region" with aria-labelledby pointing at the title. ~2 LOC. No focus management required — non-modal panels do not need it per WAI-ARIA. Backdrop dimming becomes a UX hint, not a screen-reader contract.
Option B (V1.0.2 if owner wants full modal): keep role="dialog" aria-modal="true", implement the trio:
- mounted/watch.open: this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.closeButton.focus()); store activeElement before opening for return-focus.
- Tab cycle: keydown handler intercepts Tab + Shift+Tab inside the drawer panel, mirrors KioskWizardComponent.vue:2225-2238 focusables-query pattern.
- On close: returnFocusEl.focus() to restore to the trigger pill. Mirror KioskWizardComponent.vue:2276-2280.
- Approx LOC: 30-40. Adds parity with the kiosk wizard trap pattern.

Option B is the WAI-ARIA-spec-compliant path; Option A is the pragmatic path matching the actual non-blocking UX. Owner decision needed because the ARIA contract impacts every screen-reader-using chef.
findings.blast_radius: Screen-reader chefs hear 'dialog, modal' but get non-trap behavior — confusion, NOT data loss. Sighted keyboard-only chefs can Tab out of drawer and accidentally trigger active KDS grid actions while drawer is visually 'on top'. Not a V1 ship blocker because the chef persona at Le Cayenne is sighted + uses touch/mouse — but it's a real WAI-ARIA contract drift that L5.3 audit elided.

findings.summary: Drawer renders NO allergen badge per row. KdsOrderCard renders a prominent '⚠ Allergie' pill (red, role=alert, aria-live=assertive) on the active KDS board for any order with hasAllergen=true. In Historique, the same allergen-flagged order shows only N°+status+items+variations — chef cannot scan Historique to verify which historical orders carried allergen alerts. Customer-call scenario ('I told you about my nut allergy 30 min ago — did you handle it?') would force chef to manually re-read item lines and check allergen_snapshot in a separate query.

performance.fetch_on_open_only: watch.open() triggers fetch when newVal=true (line 181-184). Drawer fetches ONLY when opened, not on KitchenDisplaySystemComponent mount — no idle network cost.
performance.50_row_cap: Backend caps at 50 rows (KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:240, locked by it_caps_at_50_orders test). Worst-case payload size: 50 orders × N items each, each item carrying composition_snapshot + allergens_snapshot. Tested by it_caps_at_50_orders endpoint test — payload is sub-second for chef machine.
performance.render_complexity: v-for on orders (max 50) × v-for on order_items (typically 1-5 per order). Total DOM nodes ~50 × 5 × 4 = ~1000. Vue 3 fast-path render is well under 100ms on a 2020-era thin client.
performance.scroll: Single overflow-y: auto on .kds-history-drawer__list (line 374). No virtualization needed at 50-row cap.
performance.no_realtime_pattern: Drawer does NOT subscribe to Pusher/Soketi or polling — fetch is per-open only. Matches K.7 K7-FIND-4 LastZReportWidget pattern (no realtime, snapshot at open). Owner-acceptable: drawer is for post-bump verification, not live ops.
performance.throttle: GET /api/admin/kds-order/history-today middleware throttle:60,1 — 60 requests / minute / IP. Adequate for chef opening drawer ~5-10 times per shift.

cumulative_day_z_close_integration.summary: Historique uses WALL-CLOCK day (Paris-local 00:00:00 → next-day 00:00:00). Z-period is fiscal-day (open 00:05 → close 23:55 per L2-HEAL-07 / G2-HEAL-06 cron). The two overlap but are NOT identical.
cumulative_day_z_close_integration.behavior_at_z_close_2355: Order bumped at 23:54 → status=PREPARED, updated_at=23:54. Visible in Historique 'today' until 23:59:59. Z closes at 23:55 → order is part of closed Z's audit chain. From 23:55-24:00, order is visible in BOTH the closed Z report AND the Historique 'today' view.
cumulative_day_z_close_integration.behavior_at_midnight: At 00:00, Historique 'today' bound rolls over: orders bumped 23:54 (still in closed Z) now disappear from Historique. New 'today' Historique is empty until new orders are bumped post-00:05 (new Z opens).
cumulative_day_z_close_integration.behavior_at_2356_to_2400: Orders bumped between 23:56-24:00 are post Z-close but pre new-Z-open. They have NO fiscal_sequence_no allocation yet (cron not run). They appear in Historique BUT will be allocated when next Z opens via FiscalSequenceService retry cron. Audit chain remains correct (NF525 invariant intact) — this is just a UI vs fiscal-day boundary skew, NOT a fiscal bug.
cumulative_day_z_close_integration.owner_recommendation: Add an operational note in chef training docs: 'Historique du jour = wall-clock day. Z report = fiscal day. Late-night orders may appear in current Historique but belong to the previous Z report.' No code change required.
cumulative_day_z_close_integration.ship_blocker: NO — fiscal correctness is preserved (independent service). UI vs fiscal day asymmetry is a documentation issue.
